patterns.title: Process exited with a non-zero code
regex: (?:exit(?:ed)? ?code|exitcode|return(?:ed)? code|error ?level|with code|exited with (?:exit )?code|result code)(?: is| set to| was| =)?\s*[:=]?\s*\(?(?P<detail>-?(?!0(?![0-9]))\d+)(?![0-9A-Za-z])
(?:exit(?:ed)? ?code|exitcode|return(?:ed)? code|with code|result code)(?: is| set to| was| =)?\s*[:=]?\s*\(?(?P<detail>0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,8})
patterns.summary: A process finished with exit code {detail}. Zero means success, so this marks a failure point but not the reason.

remediation.action: Identify the process and its documentation
remediation.detail: Look up the exit code in the vendor or installer documentation.

patterns.title: Fatal error or crash reported
patterns.summary: The log records a fatal error or crash.

remediation.action: Capture a crash dump or Event Log entry
remediation.detail: Look for an Application Error event (1000) for the same time.

remediation.action: Read the exception message and stack
remediation.detail: The first frame in your code or the vendor's usually names the failing call.
